title: MacBrains Labs ANE Research Records
description:
Versioned, source-bound public research records from MacBrains Labs. Each version is a cumulative snapshot of the archive repository; v0.1.0 holds the original public measurement summaries. Version v0.2.0 adds the diagnostic record LFM3-1.7B layer-14 diagnostic under Core ML cpuAndNeuralEngine (same chip, single device) in records/ane-record-c188def1e88a0d94018dfe99/.

Scope: same-chip, byte-reproducible on Apple A18 Pro (Mac17,5), macOS 27.2 (build 26B123), CoreML 3600.25.2; ANE execution INFERRED from Core ML compute-plan placement; no novelty claim. Single device, same chip; same-chip reruns are repeatability only, not cross-device replication. Setup profile 2f0cc0c9: 8 logged executions (5 counted and frozen, 3 pre-freeze), all disclosed; one counted run's output was deleted and its recovered record is disclosed.

Records are reviewed summaries, not peer-reviewed results. The reported measurements have not been independently replicated by this deposit. Reviewed bundle SHA-256 0d2b3f787cf0f98e6d12ed9cebd614d028b0f39e9e210e55fb93cc14ca6f49b3; reviewed package SHA-256 c188def1e88a0d94018dfe99f63aed795f58848871841d1c089d079a28aebff1.
